# A simple Markdown note

LeanMark is meant to open everyday notes like this one without starting a full
code editor. The document has a short paragraph, **one emphasized idea**, and a
small checklist.

- [x] Open quickly
- [x] Stay readable
- [ ] Add another note later

No diagram renderer is needed for this file.
